title: mariscus lentiginosus
intro: Mariscus lentiginosus, commonly known as Sensitive Fern, is a type of vascular plant that belongs to the family Thelypteridaceae. This plant is known for its health benefits, including its ability to reduce inflammation and improve respiratory issues due to its expectorant properties. The therapeutic actions of Mariscus lentiginosus are attributed to its antiseptic, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its therapeutic effects.
